intro: Picks the highest-scoring eleven from your import for a formation, with an optional minimum and maximum on what the eleven costs in total.

noImport.desktop: No players yet. In FM, open a Player Search and press <kbd>F9</kbd> or Scan search.
noImport.web: No CSV imported yet. Choose a CSV file above, or load the test data to look around.

setup.title: Setup
setup.budgetInvalid: Enter an amount like 15M, 750K or 2500000. Unreadable budgets are ignored.
setup.budgetHint: Total for the eleven. Type amounts like 15M or 750K.
setup.includeFree: Include players with no transfer value
setup.includeFreeHint: Mostly free agents. They count as {amount}.

budgetsCross.title: The minimum budget is above the maximum.
budgetsCross.body: No eleven can cost at least {min} and at most {max}.

slots.title: Not enough players to fill this formation.
slots.body: No eligible player left for: {positions}. Only natural positions from the export count.
slots.leftOut: Excluded players and players with no transfer value are left out.

budget.title: No eleven fits this budget.
budget.range: With these settings the cheapest possible eleven costs {min} and the most expensive {max}.

footnote: Each position takes one player who lists it as a natural position, scored on that position's role (1–20). The eleven shown has the highest total score of every combination that fits the budget.
unpriced: {count, plural, one {# player is} other {# players are}} left out because the export gives no price (for example "Not for Sale").

result.title: Best eleven
result.summary: Average score {average}{basis, select, potential { at full potential} other {}} · Cost {cost}{budget, select, range { (budget {min} to {max})} max { of {max}} min { (at least {min})} other {}} · Wages {wages} p/w{unknownWages, plural, =0 {} one { (# without a contract)} other { (# without a contract)}}
result.notOptimal: The search ran out of time before proving this is the very best eleven. A better one could add at most {gap} to the total score of {total}.

columns.countedTitle: Counted against the budget: {valuation, select, low {low end of range} high {high end of range} other {midpoint of range}}

hint.idle: Drag a position to another spot, or onto a position to swap them.
